what: Eli Lilly is one of the world's largest drugmakers and the maker of the best-selling diabetes and weight-loss drugs based on tirzepatide (Mounjaro and Zepbound). It also has important medicines in cancer, immunology and Alzheimer's.
customers: Patients through their doctors, insurers and governments that pay for medicines, pharmacies and hospitals.
moat: A lead in GLP-1 medicines backed by huge manufacturing capacity, patents and a pipeline including an oral weight-loss pill.
risks: US government pressure to cut drug prices
Heavy reliance on one class of drugs
Cheaper competing versions in the future
